sub_scenario.one_line: research administration officer: decline the scheduled afternoon

dialogue.content: I spent the first hour tidying the grant tracker and closing stale entries.
Anything still open?
Two items, both with owners.
The faculty diary review wrapped early today.
Any surprises in it?
None worth recording.
I manage ordinary faculty meetings in the afternoon without a problem.
Does collaborative work drain you?
No, when it follows a settled night.
Someone new shadowed me in the research office this morning.
Did that slow you down?
A little, but the questions were good ones.
I batched my replies about the deadline weeks into one message before lunch.
Cleaner than drip-feeding answers.
Much cleaner.
During emergency ethics-system coverage, I updated the grant tracker at 10:50 after handling alerts all night.
What did you need next?
I needed the afternoon free from sustained conversation.
I can have coffee with colleagues for an hour after a regular workday.
Is social contact difficult?
No, recovery after urgent coverage is the issue.
I archived last cycle's notes on the faculty diary and set up the new folder.
A fresh start?
As fresh as these things get.
Urgent messages have tightened my jaw and broken my sleep for several nights.
How does that affect you?
Long discussions leave me irritable and unable to focus.
A vendor call about the grant tracker ran long but ended well.
Worth the time?
This one, yes.
I walked through the research office checklist with the new starter.
How did they do?
Careful and quick, a good sign.
Quiet afternoon; I cleared the backlog around the deadline weeks.
A rare day.
I did not waste it.
I flagged a small inconsistency in the faculty diary records and fixed it at the source.
Root cause or symptom?
Root cause, for once.
My counselling appointment is protected at Thursday 16:30, and the counsellor is away next week.
Can it be moved?
Not without delaying the support I arranged after the alert cycle.
I sketched next week's plan for the deadline weeks before leaving.
Ahead of schedule?
Ahead enough to sleep well.
Lunch walk, then a clean pass through the grant tracker updates.
Does the walk help?
It resets the afternoon.
I keep caffeine out of my afternoons after anxious nights because it keeps me awake again.
Could coffee help you attend?
It would make the next night's recovery worse.
I compared two options for the faculty diary tooling and noted a mild preference.
Decision made?
Deferred until the trial ends.
I closed the week by updating the research office handover notes.
Anything unusual to hand over?
Blessedly little.
A Thursday afternoon offsite follows my ethics-system night coverage and overlaps my counselling appointment. Should I accept?
